strings.es: Decisiones y conflictos
Pesar una decisión, condicionales mixtos, resolver conflictos y defender una postura, e inversión enfática (Not only…, Under no circumstances…).
Puedes pesar una decisión difícil, imaginar cómo sería tu presente con otras elecciones, mediar en un conflicto y expresarte con énfasis formal.
Condicionales mixtos e inversión enfática

Los condicionales mixtos combinan tiempos: un pasado distinto con un resultado en el presente (If I had taken the job, I would be living in Berlin now) o un presente distinto con un resultado en el pasado (If I were braver, I would have said yes). En un registro formal, algunas expresiones al principio invierten auxiliar y sujeto para dar énfasis: Not only is it free, but…; Under no circumstances will we…; Only then can we…; Should you need help (= If you need help).
Si hubieras aceptado el trabajo, ya estarías hablando alemán.

strings.es: Un dilema
Contar un dilema y pesar los pros y los contras.

A dilemma es un dilema: dos opciones difíciles. Weigh up es sopesar, evaluar: I’m weighing up the pros and cons (los pros y los contras). A trade-off es lo que pierdes a cambio de lo que ganas: More money, less free time.
Cuentas un dilema y sopesas los pros y los contras.
Explicas lo que se pierde a cambio con trade-off.

strings.es: Si hubiera… ahora estaría…
Imaginar tu presente con otras decisiones: condicionales mixtos.

Condicional mixto 1: un pasado distinto cambia el presente. If + past perfect, would + verbo: If you had taken the job, you would be in Berlin now. Condicional mixto 2: un presente distinto habría cambiado el pasado. If + past simple, would have + participio: If I were braver, I would have said yes. Gut feeling es la intuición; have second thoughts, dudar.
Imaginas tu presente con un pasado distinto: If I had…, I would be…
Hablas de tu intuición y de tus dudas.

strings.es: Énfasis formal
Usar la inversión enfática en textos formales.

En avisos, correos formales y discursos: Not only + auxiliar + sujeto…, but (also)… (Not only is it free, but it is also confidential). Under no circumstances + auxiliar + sujeto (bajo ninguna circunstancia). Only then + auxiliar + sujeto (sólo entonces). Should you + verbo = If you + verbo, más formal: Should you need help, call reception.
Enfatizas con Not only…, Under no circumstances… y Only then…
Escribes condiciones formales con Should you…
Not only + auxiliar + sujeto: Not only is the service…

en.stim.b2-u12-job-offer.setting: Una amiga le cuenta a otra que tiene que decidir si se muda por trabajo.
lines: Alice: I've got a real dilemma. The Lisbon office has offered me a job as team manager.
Rosa: That's amazing! So why do you look worried?
Alice: Because I'd have to move in a month. I've been weighing up the pros and cons all week.
Rosa: What does your gut feeling say?
Alice: To go. But I'm having second thoughts because of my parents. They're getting older.
Rosa: Remember two years ago, when you turned down the job in Berlin? If you had taken it, you'd be speaking German by now.
Alice: I know. And if I were braver, I would have said yes immediately this time too.
Rosa: Every choice has a trade-off. But Lisbon is only a short flight away. You could visit them often.

en.stim.b2-u12-guide.setting: Un artículo sobre cómo tomar decisiones importantes.
lines: Big decisions are hard because there is always a trade-off: more money but less free time, adventure but less security.
First, write down the pros and cons. Seeing them on paper helps you weigh them up more calmly.
Second, ask yourself what is really at stake. Will this matter in five years? If not, do not spend weeks on it.
Third, listen to your gut feeling. Research suggests that our first reaction often contains information we are not aware of.
Finally, accept that no decision is perfect. If we had a crystal ball, we would never make mistakes. We do not, so we learn from them.

en.stim.b2-u12-neighbors.setting: Un aviso de un servicio de mediación entre vecinos.
lines: Community Mediation Service
Has a conflict with a neighbor gone on for too long? Noise, parking, trees, pets… We can help you resolve it.
Our mediators do not take sides. Their job is to help both people listen to each other and find common ground.
Not only is the service free, but it is also confidential. Under no circumstances will we share your information with the other person without your permission.
Should you need more information, please visit the community center from Monday to Friday.

en.stim.b2-u12-team-conflict.setting: Una reunión tensa de un equipo antes de presentar un proyecto.
lines: Manager: I know there has been a conflict between design and sales. Let’s sort it out today.
Leo: The sales team wants to change the design again, two days before the launch. We can't keep doing that.
Ines: We're only asking because a big client is at stake. If we lose them, everyone loses.
Leo: I understand, but I have to stand up for my team. They've worked every weekend this month.
Manager: OK. Neither side has to back down completely. Ines, send one list of changes, the essential ones only. Leo, your team decides what is possible.
Ines: That sounds fair.
Manager: Good. Only then can we finish on time.
